name: Gakuen Yousei TetraStar
original_name: 学園妖精テトラスター
source:
n 200X, two worlds collided.... "World Half and Half Phenomenon!" Two worlds got mixed due to a mysterious phenomenon called the "World Mixing Phenomenon". In the new world, there exists the devil king. Actually, the world is a battlefield of two groups, Bloody Vampire, which is led by the devil king, and Social Kingdom. There is a school which is also used as a laboratory or proving ground. One day, the Bloody Vampire suddenly attacks there.... A fierce battle of beautiful heroines in battle armor called the Tetraveil now starts....

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20090703071856/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1012270]ErogeShop[/url]]
